trans-unit.target: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_BRIGID_000_000<tab>As before, you must first stipulate the qualities you seek from your armament.
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_BRIGID_000_001<tab>Now I shall replicate the martial memories and meld them with your phantom weapon...

TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_GEROLT_000_004<tab>A martial master's vivid memories from the heat o' battle, blended with the finest craftsmanship in the bleedin' realm... An' not a trace of illusory magicks to constrain its potential!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_GEROLT_000_006<tab>Yer <var 31 ((Item)) 04E8020202 /var> an' <var 31 ((Item)) 04E8030202 /var> are the pinnacle o' war-wagin' perfection!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_GEROLT_000_007<tab>Not much else we can do here at the forge. It's time ye took yer weapon out there an' made a new set o' martial memories!
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_GEROLT_000_008<tab>Oh, if ye feel the need to tinker with it again, it'll cost ye a chunk of ecliptic arcanite. Got it?
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_SYSTEM_100_008<tab>Speak with Brigid in the phantom village if you wish to readjust the attributes of your phantom weapon.
TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE5_00980_SYSTEM_000_009<tab>The chunks of ecliptic arcanite required for readjustment can be obtained from Ermina, who is also stationed in the phantom village.
